title: Equivariance Allows Handling Multiple Nuisance Variables When Analyzing Pooled Neuroimaging Datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain any benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not address religion, faith, or related topics. The central focus is on a machine learning method for pooling neuroimaging datasets while controlling for nuisance variables like scanner type and participant age. The experiments are conducted on medical imaging (ADNI, ADCP) and standard fairness datasets (German, Adult).
